fusions.name: Come Up Beneath
fusions.desc: You erupt under the target, dealing 13 earth damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Undermined Ground
fusions.desc: Collapses the ground under every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 earth damage and leaving each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Short Tunnel
fusions.desc: You dig under and come up at a spot up to 6 tiles away.

fusions.name: Bedrock Backing
fusions.desc: Every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
